name: Contract Bridge
tagline: Bid a contract with your partner, then make it with dummy's help.
rulesSummary: Partners sit across. The dealer calls first: bid a number of tricks over six (1–7) in a suit or no trumps (♣ < ♦ < ♥ < ♠ < NT), pass, double an opponent's bid, or redouble their double. Three passes after a bid end the auction.
The first of the winning side to name the final suit is declarer. The player on their left leads; then declarer's partner lays their hand face up as dummy, and declarer plays both hands.
Duplicate scoring each deal: tricks bid count 20 (♣ ♦), 30 (♥ ♠) or 40 then 30 (NT); 100+ is a game bonus, plus slam bonuses. Going down gives the defenders 50 or 100 a trick (more if doubled).
Chicago rotation over four deals: nobody, then the dealer's side, then everyone is vulnerable. Highest total wins.
